ownerWaiver.question: Quick Charts 5.0.0 has had no manual screen-reader or device test. It rests on automated conformance (the unit, clean-room and browser suites, plus the app's first-host CI) and your own review of the preview. Waive the manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance, and authorize publishing 5.0.0 to npm?
ownerWaiver.statement: Asked by his coordinating session whether to waive the manual accessibility and advertised-browser acceptance for Quick Charts 5.0.0 and authorize its publication, Joey chose "Waive and authorize (Recommended)".

ownerDecision.manualAcceptance: waived by owner for this release
ownerDecision.npmPublishApproval: delegated by Joey to his coordinating session, which approves the npm-publish environment once the validation job passes. Asked "Two steps need the owner's approval in GitHub: the npm-publish step, and the app's production deploy if it asks. Approve them yourself, or have me approve them for you?", he chose "Approve them for me (Recommended)".
